sections.title: Shopping with Clarity and Confidence
paragraphs: At Rootedrealm, operated by D & V Enterprises, Inc., our goal is to make online shopping convenient, informative, and transparent.
We offer products across electronics, computers, gaming, lawn and garden, outdoor power equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, saunas, and home improvement.
We recognize that customers need accurate product information and understandable purchasing policies, especially when shopping for technical equipment and higher-value products.

sections.title: 1. Clear Product Information
paragraphs: We aim to provide accurate product titles, descriptions, images, specifications, and available product details.
Customers should review product dimensions, compatibility, installation requirements, and manufacturer instructions before placing an order.

sections.title: 2. Transparent Pricing
paragraphs: Product prices are displayed during shopping and checkout.
We offer free standard shipping throughout the United States, with no minimum order requirement.
Applicable taxes and the final payable total are displayed during checkout.

sections.title: 3. Reliable Order Processing
paragraphs: Our standard order handling period is 1–2 business days, Monday through Friday.
Orders are reviewed, prepared, and packaged before being handed to the shipping carrier.
During high-volume periods, processing may occasionally take longer. We aim to communicate meaningful delays.

sections.title: 4. Clear Delivery Estimates
paragraphs: Our standard delivery estimates are:
Delivery estimates may vary due to carrier operations, weather, or other circumstances.

sections.title: 5. Customer-Friendly Returns
paragraphs: We accept eligible defective and non-defective returns within 30 days.
Standard non-defective returns must meet the applicable new-condition requirements.
Our policy includes free return shipping and no restocking fees.
Direct exchanges are not accepted. Customers seeking a different item may return an eligible purchase and place a new order.

sections.title: 6. Customer Support

sections.title: 7. Responsible Product Information
paragraphs: For products such as chainsaws, power equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, and electronic devices, we encourage customers to follow manufacturer safety instructions and applicable installation requirements.

sections.title: 8. Privacy and Security
paragraphs: We recognize the importance of protecting customer information.
We aim to use appropriate safeguards and disclose relevant information-handling practices through our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 9. Continuous Improvement
paragraphs: We value customer feedback and aim to improve product information, order communication, and customer assistance.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Welcome to the Rootedrealm FAQ Center. Find answers to common questions about our products, orders, shipping, returns, refunds, and customer support.

items.question: What is Rootedrealm?
items.answer: Rootedrealm is a US-based multi-category online retailer operated by D & V Enterprises, Inc.

items.question: Where is Rootedrealm located?
items.answer: Our published business address is 3920 Gunn Hwy, Tampa, FL 33618, United States.

items.question: What products do you sell?
items.answer: Our categories include electronics, gaming consoles, computer monitors, 3D printers, computer components, lawn and garden products, outdoor power equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, saunas, and home improvement products.

items.question: How can I contact customer support?
items.answer: Call +1 (813) 963-6899 during our published customer service hours.

items.question: What are your business hours?
items.answer: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse our online store, select your products, add them to your cart, and complete checkout.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: The payment methods currently supported are displayed at checkout.

items.question: Can I cancel an order?
items.answer: You may request cancellation before the order is dispatched. Contact customer support as soon as possible.

items.question: Can I change my shipping address?
items.answer: Contact us promptly. Changes may not be possible once the order has shipped.

items.question: Will I receive an order confirmation?
items.answer: After a successful purchase, order confirmation information should be sent to the email address provided at checkout.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Yes. Standard shipping is free throughout the United States.

items.question: Is there a minimum purchase requirement?
items.answer: No. Free standard shipping applies to all orders.

items.question: How long does processing take?
items.answer: Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Transit generally takes 3–7 business days.

items.question: What is the total estimated delivery time?
items.answer: Most orders are estimated to arrive within 4–9 business days.

items.question: What counts as a business day?
items.answer: Monday through Friday, excluding applicable public holidays.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Our published free shipping policy covers the United States. International shipping is not offered under this policy.

items.question: Can I track my order?
items.answer: Shipment tracking information will be provided when available after dispatch.

items.question: What if my order is delayed?
items.answer: Contact customer support with your order number so we can review the available shipping information.

items.question: What is your return window?
items.answer: 30 days.

items.question: Do you accept returns for defective products?
items.answer: Yes.

items.question: Do you accept returns for non-defective products?
items.answer: Yes, provided they meet the applicable eligibility requirements.

items.question: What condition must a standard return be in?
items.answer: Non-defective products must be in new condition.

items.question: Are exchanges accepted?
items.answer: No. We do not offer direct exchanges.

items.question: Is return shipping free?
items.answer: Yes. Our policy provides a free return label included in the package.

items.question: Do you charge restocking fees?
items.answer: No. Our restocking fee is $0.00.

items.question: How long does refund processing take?
items.answer: Our published refund processing period is 10 days.

items.question: How are refunds issued?
items.answer: Approved refunds are generally returned to the original payment method.

items.question: What if my return label is missing?
items.answer: Contact customer service for assistance before shipping the product.

items.question: Do your products include warranties?
items.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the product and applicable manufacturer terms.

items.question: Do you provide installation services?
items.answer: Installation is not included unless explicitly stated in the product listing or purchase agreement.

items.question: Can I ask about product compatibility?
items.answer: Yes. Contact customer service with the product model and your requirements.

items.question: What if a product arrives damaged?
items.answer: Contact us promptly with your order number and supporting photographs, where available.
